title: Maruti Suzuki Dzire: 20,649 dispatches in October 2026, more than the next seven sedans on the top-10 sedan dispatch table combined (Aura 7,349, Aeris 4,005, Amaze 3,337, Slavia 2,638, Virtus 1,888, Verna 775, City 596 = 20,588); Dzire 49.4% of the top-10 total of 41,773 (+12.3% from 37,211); Slavia +60.1%, ahead of Virtus; Aeris is Tata's renamed Tigor facelift, launched September 2026 (GaadiWaadi and Autopunditz, 10 Nov; Autocar India, 25 Sep)
